shared_elements: horizontal registers or bands of decoration
rounded rectangular or block-like carved compartments
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces are upright stones covered with shallow carving arranged partly in stacked horizontal zones, including block-like and curving motifs. The biggest difference is that A appears dominated by dense, abstract glyph-like panels on a narrow weathered monolith, while B has larger, more open figurative reliefs and bands on a broad slab.
